title: Mining Buyer
body:
Builder: MSET <mob vnum> SHOPKEEPER ON, then MSET <mob vnum> SHOPTYPE mining.
Buys iron/steel/chakra ores and their smelted ingots. Pays 1.5 times the standard item sale price, compared with 0.5 at general stores. Use SELL <name>, SELL ALL <name>, BUY and LIST.

Quick builder setup: MSET <mob vnum> FLAGS ShopMining. The Shopkeeper role is implied.
